_comment: Reliability validation batch plan — declared and frozen BEFORE any batch run (hashed in freeze_manifest.json). Every run listed here is executed and reported; nothing is added, dropped or rerun based on outcomes. A patch to any frozen file invalidates the batch (new version, full restart). RV-4 = RV-3 plan unchanged (same primary model, provider settings, batch composition, fault schedule and fallback configuration) to isolate the effect of the RV-4 patches (IDR-RV4-08); only the implementation (P2-P4) and the evaluator (v2: evaluate_mock6_autonomous m6-auto-2.0, evaluate_human_gate hg-2.0, classify cls-2.0, aggregate agg-2.0) differ.

A.desc: fresh continuous Mock #6 autonomous runs (primary model)

B.desc: fresh continuous golden scenarios A-D, live reasoning

C.desc: autonomous Human Gate E2E (first run = primary verdict; all reported)

_pilots: Pre-freeze pilots (not part of any batch): nemotron-3-super example scenario RWKL 12/12 calls OK; nemotron-3-super Mock #6 1 run EARLY_CORRECT RWKL; Human Gate scenario pilot 1 HOLD_VALID (Reasoner-raised critical VOB 'are timeout retries the sole source?' blocked the protected action; scenario then given discriminating PSP evidence and the CHG-71 red herring removed); pilot 2 PASS H1-H10. Secondary NIM models rejected for latency/availability: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (no response on full-size prompts in 20 min), nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b (27-127 s/call, INVALID_SCHEMA), openai/gpt-oss-20b (73-130 s/call).
